root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from the `l2cap_ecred_data_rcv` function in the Bluetooth L2CAP subsystem failing to validate that the socket buffer contains at least two bytes before reading the SDU length field, resulting in an out-of-bounds memory read.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that `l2cap_ecred_data_rcv()` reads the SDU length using `get_unaligned_le16()` "without first verifying that skb contains at least L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE (2) bytes," and the patch fixes this by adding a `pskb_may_pull(skb, L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE)` check immediately before the read operation.
